name: azureblob

connection_string.title: Connection string
connection_string.description: Full storage connection string (alternative to account+key)

sas_url.title: Container SAS URL
sas_url.description: Container-scoped SAS URL (alternative to account credentials; container field then unused)

container.title: Container
container.description: Blob container name (required unless a container SAS URL is used)

endpoint.title: Blob endpoint
endpoint.description: Override service endpoint for Azurite/custom clouds, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:10000/devstoreaccount1

allow_local.title: Allow local/loopback and private/internal targets (network guard off; needed for Azurite)

record_element.title: XML record element
record_element.description: Element delimiting one record (XML only); empty treats each child of the root as a record

columns.title: Fixed-width columns
columns.description: Column layout, in order (fixedw only). Columns are contiguous; a column with no name is filler. Required when format is fixedw.

name.title: Field name
name.description: Record field name; empty means filler (skipped on read, padded on write)

scale.title: Implied decimals
scale.description: Decimal places implied by the layout when the digits carry no point (decimal/zoned)

align.title: Alignment
align.description: Defaults to right for numbers, left otherwise

trim.title: Trim
trim.description: Padding stripped on read; default picks by pad character so a zero-padded number keeps its trailing zeros

layout.title: Time layout
layout.description: Go time layout for temporal columns (default 20060102 / 150405 / 20060102150405)

location.title: Time zone
location.description: IANA zone the column is written in; empty is UTC
